title: Update on Negotiations for Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership
what_it_is: Update on Negotiations for Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership

sections.label: RCEP free trade agreement
sections.summary: RCEP is a 16-party FTA under negotiation between ASEAN member states and six ASEAN FTA Partners, with two chapters concluded.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: The Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP) is a 16-party free trade agreement (FTA) currently under negotiation between the 10 Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) member states and the six ASEAN FTA Partners, that is, China, Japan, Republic of Korea, India, New Zealand and Australia.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: Accounting for almost half of the world's population and a third of the world's gross domestic product, the RCEP is envisaged to be a modern, comprehensive, high quality and mutually beneficial economic partnership agreement that will deepen ASEAN's economic integration with the region.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: Since the launch of RCEP negotiations in November 2012, there have been 20 formal negotiating rounds and eight RCEP Ministerial Meetings.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: To date, two chapters have been concluded and they are: the Economic and Technical Cooperation (ECOTECH) and Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) Chapters.

sections.label: RCEP Ministers endorse guidance document
sections.summary: In September 2017, RCEP Ministers discussed and endorsed the Key Elements for Significant Outcomes by End of 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: In September 2017, RCEP Ministers discussed and endorsed a guidance document, the Key Elements for Significant Outcomes by End of 2017.

sections.label: Second revised offers tabled
sections.summary: RCEP Parties have tabled the second revised offers across Goods, Services and Investments.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: RCEP Parties have tabled the second revised offers across Goods, Services and Investments.

sections.label: RCEP dispute settlement mechanism
sections.summary: The RCEP will include a dispute settlement mechanism for consultations and settlement of disputes.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: The RCEP will also include a dispute settlement mechanism to provide an effective, efficient and transparent process for consultations and settlement of disputes.

sections.label: Singapore commitment to RCEP
sections.summary: Singapore remains committed to working closely with RCEP counterparts to bring the agreement to fruition.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: Singapore remains committed to work closely with our RCEP counterparts to bring the agreement to fruition.
